AI & Machine Learning.title: Machine Learning Engineering & AI Architecture
AI & Machine Learning.description: Progress from foundational model training and vision pipelines to principal AI system architecture and research leadership.

levels.title: Junior ML / AI Developer
levels.focusArea: Model training, data preprocessing, scikit-learn, PyTorch fundamentals, and experiment tracking.
keyResponsibilities: Prepare clean datasets and perform exploratory data analysis
Train baseline classification and regression models
Evaluate metrics (precision, recall, mAP) and document experiments

levels.title: Machine Learning Engineer / Computer Vision Engineer
levels.focusArea: End-to-end model training, real-time computer vision pipelines, ONNX quantization, and containerized inference microservices.
keyResponsibilities: Develop state-of-the-art vision or NLP models using PyTorch / YOLO
Optimize latency via TensorRT, ONNX runtime, and GPU clustering
Build automated CI/CD testing and inference REST APIs

levels.title: Senior ML / Computer Vision Architect
levels.focusArea: Large-scale distributed training, production MLOps telemetry, real-time edge acceleration, and system resilience.
keyResponsibilities: Architect distributed multi-node GPU training workflows
Design real-time drift telemetry and automatic retraining triggers
Lead technical reviews and mentor engineering squads

levels.title: Principal AI Systems Architect / Director of AI
levels.focusArea: Organizational AI strategy, multi-modal foundation models, enterprise data governance, and cross-functional technology direction.
keyResponsibilities: Establish corporate technology vision for AI and compute infrastructure
Formulate research partnerships and IP strategy
Direct multi-million dollar GPU infrastructure budgets and architectural standards

Embedded Systems.title: Embedded Systems & Firmware Architecture
Embedded Systems.description: Progress from bare-metal peripheral programming and RTOS drivers to principal hardware-software systems architecture.

levels.title: Junior Embedded / Firmware Engineer
levels.focusArea: Microcontroller programming, basic protocol drivers (UART, I2C, SPI), and lab instrumentation.
keyResponsibilities: Write basic firmware routines in C on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers
Debug signals using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
Implement peripheral communication drivers for sensors

levels.title: Embedded Systems Engineer / RTOS Developer
levels.focusArea: Deterministic multitasking with FreeRTOS, secure bootloaders, low-power optimization, and bus protocols.
keyResponsibilities: Architect deterministic multi-task RTOS firmware
Implement secure OTA firmware updates and custom bootloaders
Conduct signal integrity and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing

levels.title: Senior Embedded / Systems Architect
levels.focusArea: Custom board bring-up, silicon validation, safety-critical architecture (ISO 26262/MISRA), and edge AI integration.
keyResponsibilities: Lead new silicon bring-up and custom hardware architecture
Enforce strict MISRA-C and functional safety compliance
Design ultra-low-power energy harvesting algorithms

levels.title: Principal Embedded Architect / VP of Hardware Engineering
levels.focusArea: Hardware product roadmap, custom ASIC/SoC specification, factory production scaling, and cross-discipline governance.
keyResponsibilities: Define next-generation hardware platform architecture
Manage manufacturing partnerships and mass production yield
Direct multi-disciplinary electrical and firmware engineering organizations

Software Engineering.title: Software Engineering & Distributed Systems
Software Engineering.description: Progress from component development and REST APIs to high-scale distributed systems and enterprise engineering leadership.

levels.title: Junior Software Engineer
levels.focusArea: Frontend UI components, backend CRUD endpoints, relational schema design, and unit testing.
keyResponsibilities: Implement responsive React components using TypeScript
Build RESTful API endpoints with Node.js or FastAPI
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests

levels.title: Full Stack / Backend Engineer
levels.focusArea: High-throughput microservices, distributed caching, complex state management, and CI/CD pipelines.
keyResponsibilities: Design scalable microservice communication patterns
Optimize database queries, indexing, and connection pools
Maintain containerized deployments with Docker and CI/CD

levels.title: Staff / Lead Software Architect
levels.focusArea: High-concurrency distributed systems, zero-downtime database migrations, micro-frontends, and technical mentoring.
keyResponsibilities: Architect high-availability event-driven distributed platforms
Establish engineering best practices and architectural guardrails
Lead cross-team technical design reviews

levels.title: Principal Architect / VP of Engineering
levels.focusArea: Enterprise software strategy, cloud cost optimization, developer productivity infrastructure, and executive leadership.
keyResponsibilities: Define long-term enterprise technology roadmap
Direct architecture across dozens of distributed services
Align technical milestones with business revenue objectives
